text.p: Here are highlights of stories in Skopje press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories nor does it vouch for their accuracy.

- Internal debt in Macedonia has dropped by 92.6 million German marks after the first round of the implementation of the intercompany debt settlement scheme, the payment operations office said. Macedonia's total internal debt is 1.66 billion German marks.

- Macedonian Prime Minister Branko Crvenkovski will visit Yugoslavia on Wendesday and Thursday. Crvenkovski is expected to sign several bilateral agreements and hold talks on further cooperation with his Yugoslav counterpart Radoje Kontic.
- U.S agency for trade and development donated five construction machines worth $1.7 million to Macedonia for the construction of the east-west corridor.
- Court administration strike will be suspended on Tuesday to September 5. The government has accepted the strikers' demands for a salary raise but has not agreed on the percentage of the raise.

- Macedonian opposition parties, both ethnic Albanian and Macedonian, consider joining forces to press government for early elections. Large opposition party VMRO-DPMNE announced organisation of large protest rallies in September.

- Macedonian constitutional court ordered the Tetovo municipal council to immediately remove the Albanian flag in front of the municipal building. If this is not done the court will ask the government to forcibly remove the flag. Tetovo municipal officials will wait for the parliamentary discussion on the issue which is on the agenda on Wednesday. -- Mircela Casule, Skopje newsroom +389 91 201 196
